jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager - GTM Business Planning
jobs.location: Atlanta, Georgia, USA; Portland, Oregon, USA; San Francisco, California, USA; Toronto, Canada
jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

About the Opportunity

New Relic is looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager – GTM Business Planning to own the operating system behind how we plan, pay, and scale our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. Sitting at the intersection of Sales, Finance, and Systems, you will architect the annual GTM plan, design incentive compensation programs, and govern processes across quota, territory, and comp data.

What You'll Do

- GTM Planning & Architecture: Own the annual planning cycle end-to-end, building capacity models and territory frameworks to ensure optimal market coverage and alignment with targets.

- Incentive Compensation Design: Partner with FP&A to architect and govern financially sound sales incentive plans and compensation policies that motivate seller behavior, drive strategic priorities, and eliminate payout leakage.

- Quota Management & Strategy: Establish fair quota methodologies, manage ongoing adjustments for transfers/hires, and evaluate rep productivity to handle market shifts.

- Operations & Governance: Govern monthly sales compensation data within Salesforce and downstream systems to maintain audit-ready accuracy across territories and quotas.

- Systems & Automation: Own the deployment of annual territories and quotas in Salesforce, drive the roadmap for GTM planning systems, and lead automation initiatives to eliminate manual effort and scale operations.

This Role Requires

- B2B SaaS Experience: 6–8+ years in Revenue/Sales Operations, Sales Comp, FP&A, or GTM Strategy within high-growth, consumption-based B2B SaaS technology companies.

- Annual Planning Execution: Demonstrated success leading annual GTM planning cycles end-to-end (capacity modeling, territory carving, quota setting, and Salesforce deployment).

- Analytics & Technical Proficiency: Advanced expertise in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets), business intelligence platforms (Looker, Tableau), and Salesforce architecture (flow automation, custom objects, and schemas). Proven background collaborating with IT and Business Applications teams on CRM data structures and process automation.

- Builder & Leadership Mindset: A "zero-to-one" operator skilled at building scalable GTM systems, translating vague business problems into technical workflows, and leading cross-functional projects.

- Communication & Education: Exceptional stakeholder management and executive presentation skills, paired with a BS/BA degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a quantitative field.

Bonus Points If You Have

- Experience with AI-powered GTM tools for predictive scoring, forecasting, or territory carving.

- Intermediate SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or AWS data pipelines.

- Advanced degree (MBA or related master's).

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

jobs.location: Atlanta, Georgia, USA; Portland, Oregon, USA; San Francisco, California, USA; Toronto, Canada

As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your Opportunity:

Are you driven by the challenge of turning complex operational processes into seamless, high-performing systems? New Relic is looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to own the technical and automation engine behind our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization.

As part of the GTM Planning & Process team, you will sit right at the intersection of business strategy, field execution, and cutting-edge technology. You will serve as a strategic partner across our revenue organization, eliminating operational friction, scaling systems, and building solutions that directly impact our growth trajectory.

What You'll Do:

- GTM Strategy & Automation: Drive the GTM technology roadmap (including Salesforce, Clay, and Salesloft). You will pilot emerging AI capabilities and transform manual steps into efficient, automated workflows.

- Technical Execution & Quality: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into clear user stories, technical specs, and UAT testing plans.

- Data Governance & Analytics: Define key system-level performance metrics, build automated dashboards, and collaborate with Data & Analytics to maintain a trusted source of truth.

- Enablement & Change Management: Guide field adoption of new system features by creating clear documentation, leading enablement sessions, and executing change management strategies.

- Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, and Customer Adoption to streamline business rules and build a customer lifecycle (from initial land, onboarding, and adoption, to value realization and expansion)

This Role Requires:

- 6 to 8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS across Revenue Operations, Field Sales Ops, or GTM Systems Architecture

- A strong functional understanding of Salesforce (including how data flows and integrates between systems) alongside Business Intelligence tools like Tableau or advanced Excel

- Experience leading cross-functional projects, writing detailed user stories, and managing delivery using Agile/Scrum methodologies in Jira.

- A strong builder mindset with a knack for translating qualitative business needs into scalable technical designs.

- Relevant professional experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

Bonus Points:

- Experience with modern GTM tools such as Salesforce CPQ, LeanData, or Clay.

- Exposure to implementing AI capabilities for predictive scoring or automated routing.

- Practical SQL skills and familiarity with Snowflake or AWS data pipelines.

- An advanced degree (such as an MBA or related Master's degree).

jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your Opportunity

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Associate HRBP to join our team in Tokyo. In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day HR operations and provide essential support across the entire employee lifecycle. You will work closely with the local management team to ensure a positive work environment while maintaining compliance with Japanese labor standards.

This role is critical in ensuring a positive employee experience and supporting our growth in the Japanese market. Beyond compliance, you will act as a cultural bridge and a dedicated local resource, ensuring our Tokyo team feels connected to our global mission while fostering a collaborative and effective team environment. This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional looking to grow their career in a dynamic, international environment.

Key Responsibilities

Performance Management

- Partners with HRBP to advise managers and employees on all aspects of the New Relic performance management process both informal and formal.

- Provides guidance to the business on the appropriate solutions while taking into account New Relic’s policies as well as local laws and regulations.

- Support on the content of written and verbal informal performance feedback, coaching plans, and/or behavioral/formal improvement plans

Employee Relations (ER)

- Conducts ER investigations as a lead and/or support aligned with New Relic’s policies as well as local laws and regulations.

- Resolves and addresses ER relations issues, disciplinary actions, and employee grievances

- Ensures internal database is kept up to date with all investigations and outcomes logged in a timely manner

Partnership with our People Team functions

- Partners with Talent Acquisition on job leveling, role descriptions, offers and can participate in interview panels when required

- Partners with People Operations to address and resolve open inquiries (tickets) initiated by employees and managers that require HRBP team input to close. Topics can be related to compensation, benefits, leaves, HRIS changes, etc

- Partners on annual programs owned by other teams, such as annual compensation reviews, policy changes/rollouts, engagement survey, and annual performance review process

- Conducts exit interviews and summarizes trends, while ensuring information is logged correctly within the system for reporting purposes

- Leads and/ or serves on special HR assigned project teams

- Supports compliance of all activities with the Japan Labor Standards Act and internal Work Rules (Shugyo Kisoku), security and integrity of data including personal and confidential information.

- Provides administrative support for monthly payroll processing and social insurance procedures (Shakai Hoken).

- Leads and/ or serves on special HR assigned project teams

Business Engagement

- Makes it a priority to lean in and understand the goals and strategies of the business so that they factor into our support and outcomes

- Collaborates with leadership to align HR strategies with overall business objectives.

- Analyzes data and trends to recommend, develop, and deliver on plans to improve employee experiences, including attrition, engagement, dei, retention and performance

- Acts as liaison for change management

May perform other responsibilities as assigned

This role requires

- 5+ of experience in an HR Generalist role in Japan.

- Fluent Japanese and business-level English (written and verbal) are required for communication with global stakeholders.

- Solid understanding of Japanese labor laws and social insurance systems.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain high levels of confidentiality.

Bonus points if you have

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.

- HR experience within a global SaaS organization

- Experience using G-Suite, Workday, Culture Amp a plus

- Experience working in fast paced, highly matrixed organization, across multiple time zones

Why Join Us?

- Cultural Impact: Serve as a vital resource and bridge for the Tokyo office, reinforcing a supportive and collaborative working environment.

- Global Exposure: Gain exposure to a wide variety of HR functions in a global setting.

- Professional Growth: A collaborative team environment with opportunities for professional growth.

- Competitive Rewards: Competitive compensation and benefits.

- Flexibility: Flexible working arrangements (Hybrid).

jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

We are seeking a Director of Strategic Sourcing, Procurement and Travel to lead the enterprise-wide Vendor Management Office.  This serves as a senior leadership  role driving high-impact RFx initiatives, complex commercial negotiations, and supplier performance, while driving transformation, governance, and long-term value creation across the business.

You'll provide internal client support, handle interaction between stakeholders and suppliers for strategic sourcing purchase requests, and contract management acting as the liaison to assigned lines of business through the VMO. We need a cross-functional experienced professional with the ability to see and link the pieces of the big picture together across functions to help our business grow and thrive.

This role will be responsible for handling vendor relationships, empowered to negotiate strategic contracts, and supporting New Relic spend. The ideal candidate will view vendors from a life cycle perspective with a focus on reduced cost, increased customer happiness, and greater business impact.

What you'll do

- Develop and maintain positive business relationships with suppliers as well as key stakeholders and budget owners and collaborate with internal customer/category groups in a personable, approachable manner

- Sponsor and lead high-complexity, mission-critical RFx initiatives

- Lead and support complex commercial negotiations across software, SaaS, cloud, hardware, and professional services

- Own and strengthen critical supplier relationships, resolving issues and driving continuous improvement.

- Lead the Travel and Expense function for the company

- Develop and implement sourcing strategies, procurement & travel policies, and governance across all spend categories

- Partner closely with Legal, Security, Finance, and Technology leaders to align on cross-functional goals

- Drive cost optimization, market benchmarking, and total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis

- Lead organizational change and strategic procurement programs aligned to business objectives.

- Manage departmental budget and define performance metrics and evaluation criteria

- Build, lead, and develop high-performing, distributed procurement teams

- Provide executive-level communication, guidance, and reporting on procurement objectives and outcomes.

This role requires

- Bachelor/Master’s Degree business, information systems, or related field and 10+ years of direct experience in a strategic sourcing management role.

- 5+ years of experience leading a team

- 10+ years of experience negotiating commercial contracts, preparing and redlining in word, for software and hardware licenses, professional services agreements, statements of work, SaaS, Cloud Subscriptions, and amendments to existing contracts.

- 10+ years of direct experience in a lead / principal role.

- Experience leading Travel and Expense function Globally

- Ability to build contract price modelling using a fact-based data driven approach in Excel to provide sourcing recommendations.

- Experience with procurement software (i.e. Coupa, NetSuite, Oracle and JIRA).

- Experience formulating methods to develop and analyze various category portfolios, including market price benchmarking and total cost ownership (TCO) analysis.

- Keen ability to proactively identify/propose cost reductions and continuous supplier performance improvement opportunities

- Experience Building and developing high performance Global teams with a focus on learning and career growth.

- Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

jobs.location: Atlanta, Georgia, USA; Austin, Texas, USA; Charleston, South Carolina, USA; Chicago, Illinois, USA; Dallas, Texas, USA; Detroit, Michigan, USA; Houston, Texas, USA; Indianapolis, Indiana, USA; Las Vegas, Nevada, USA; Memphis, Tennessee, USA; Miami, Florida, USA; Orlando, Florida, USA; Phoenix, Arizona, USA; Provo, Utah, USA; Salt Lake City, Utah, USA
jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

New Relic is looking for a strategic, high-energy Senior Cloud Partner Sales Manager to scale our co-sell ecosystem with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft (Azure).
In this role, you won't just be managing partnerships—you will be a critical growth engine. You will act as the vital bridge between New Relic’s internal sales leadership and our cloud partner counterparts. Your primary mission is to build deep relationships, align go-to-market (GTM) strategies, and execute high-velocity co-sell motions that directly accelerate pipeline and revenue growth.

What you'll do

GTM Strategy & Sales Alignment

- Bridge the Gap: Serve as the primary liaison between New Relic’s internal sales leadership (AVPs, RVPs, and Account Executives) and AWS/MSFT partner sales teams.

- Co-Sell Execution: Drive the day-to-day co-sell motion, mapping accounts, identifying new logos, and accelerating existing deals via AWS Marketplace and Azure Marketplace.

- Pipeline Generation: Build and execute regional partner plans that generate qualified pipeline, leveraging cloud provider funding programs, incentives, and credits.

Relationship & Alliance Management

- Build Cloud Networks: Cultivate deep, trusted relationships with AWS and MSFT Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Cloud Account Managers, and field sales leadership.

- Evangelism: Educate cloud partner sales teams on New Relic’s value proposition, ensuring we are top-of-mind for cloud migration, modernization, and observability initiatives.

Operations & Governance

- Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs): Own and lead QBRs with both internal sales leaders and cloud partner stakeholders to track KPIs, pipeline health, and strategic wins.

- Deal Governance: Navigate and optimize cloud marketplace listing mechanisms, private offers (CPPO/MPO), and cloud consumption commitments (EDPs/MACC).

This role requires

- Experience: 7+ years of experience in Enterprise Software Sales, Business Development, or Partner/Alliance Management—with at least 5+ years specifically managing AWS or Microsoft Azure partnerships.

- Co-Sell Expertise: Proven track record of navigating the AWS and/or MSFT co-sell ecosystem, cloud marketplaces, and field organization structures.

- Sales Acumen: Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles. You know how to talk to an Enterprise Account Executive and help them close deals faster using cloud partnerships.

- Influence & Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and external stakeholders without direct authority.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
